description: Call POST /generate with raw API parameters, for models or options the dedicated tools don't cover (e.g. persona-slot inputs, webhooks). Models: interior, exterior, sketch, render, magicprompt, magicwand, moodboard, landscape, enhance, expand, vector, removefurniture, segment, segmentprompt, fluw, fluwvector, pattern, changebg, removebg, video, 3dgen. Parameter reference: https://luw-ai.gitbook.io/api. Image fields (image, end_image, mask_image, material_image, style_transfer, extra_image_1…6) also accept local paths and data: URIs. Spends credits like the model's own tool.
